blurb: Isle of Hope Marina provides boat storage and dockage with amenities including fuel, WiFi, and mechanical services. It offers event spaces such as an overwater pavilion and a clubhouse for gatherings. The marina has a long history and is located on the Intracoastal Waterway near Savannah.
